name: Living & Dining
body: Open concept, tighter and louder and more intentional than Ghost Haven's vast common room. A massive multi-configuration sectional, a flat-screen, a Vesper-wired sound system, and enough throw pillows to build a defensive fortification, which Goldie has done more than once. A fireplace anchors one wall, its mantel holding Lili's stolen chapstick in a frame, Arianna's first forged ring, and a move-in-day photo in which exactly zero of the twenty-eight are looking at the camera.
